alt:
The line chart shows the Market Basket Measure Poverty Index (MBM-PI) in Canada over time.
It has a vertical axis showing index values, from 0 to 120, by increments of 20.
It has a horizontal axis showing years, from 2015 to 2024, by increments of 1 year.
The line begins with an index value of 100 in 2015. There is a general downward trend until 2019, followed by a sharp decrease to 44.8 in 2020. From 2020, the poverty index increased for three consecutive years to 74.4 in 2023. It decreased slightly to 73.7 in 2024.
modifications: Resized and letterboxed to 16:9; no AI generation
